title: Linear bound on coefficient confidence bits
statement: Let $n,k,b$ be natural numbers, and let $P\subseteq[n]$. Define $T_0=1$ and $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, and put $r=\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$ and $L=\lceil\log_2 T_k\rceil+2(r+1)+5$. For a failure parameter $\delta=1/(2^{b+1}T_k)$ and coefficient confidence $\delta/(4|\mathcal F|)$, where $\mathcal F$ is the family of subsets of the coordinates outside $P$ of size at most $r$, the number of failure bits is at most $L(n+1)(b+1)$.
